We've been having a conversation with our clients for the last month or so. Our quant systems pivot us to a risk-off macro regime which is a signal to our clients across the global byside to take down their growth and tighten their net exposure.

There's three wealth taxes on the ballot, California, Colorado, Washington.
If those wealth tax votes go in a way that's obviously not favorable for Wall Street, you're going to have two catalysts that are negative.
One catalyst is you're going to force billionaires to actually, you know, sell assets and and and raise cash that's negative for the market on the near-term basis.

But from a longer-term basis in our opinion, we think that will be a signal for 2028 and you're going to get a signal that candidates will start to campaign on significant redistributed policies which will challenge the free cash flow assumptions that hockey stick back to positive in 2028, 2029, and
Our macro weather model currently views the positioning cycle as a meaningful headwind for asset markets.
Well, respectfully we would have said to sell in September when our systems triggered risk-off.
In our opinion, if you're if you're fully invested here, you need to at the bare minimum downshift your beta, rotate into things that are less high beta, less cyclical, up in quality.
